titles.title: Dear Customer, This Is Time Life Insurance Company
Thank You, Customer. This is Time-Life Insurance Company.

description:
In an era of living long with illness, what if you had the chance to live your last month healthily? There exists a unique insurance in the world that guarantees healthy time to terminal patients! A vivid report on fulfilling customer wishes by insurance king Lee Yeon-hong, who dreams of quitting the insurance company that takes responsibility for customers’ last wishes, and curious Gen-Z newcomer Kim Seon-yu.
